## A shell where the work is {.i-terminal}

Opening a terminal and `cd`-ing to the project is easy, but doing it
again and again is a pain. The shell terminal opens your login shell in
the session's folder, at the chat's right. Shells are tabs: the **+** or
[⌘T]{.kbd} opens one, [⌘W]{.kbd} closes it, [⌘K]{.kbd} clears the
screen, and you can drag tabs to reorder them. They stay open until you
close them or quit.

Paste a picture and it lands as the path of a file. A selection can copy
itself when you let go (Settings, Terminal). Programs that use the mouse
get its clicks and scrolls, and the Mac's line keys work ([⌘←]{.kbd},
[⌘→]{.kbd}, [⌘⌫]{.kbd}). The look is inspired by
[Kaku](https://kaku.fun), in the window's own colors and font.

The same shell opens beside the install steps on the Agents page, for
the commands they give. It shares the right side with the
[agent terminal](agent.qmd): one shows at a time.
